description: Three-axis evidence summary for the erg13A/erg13B division-of-labour hypothesis, with catalytic residue table, orthology asymmetry and literature footprint
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os, json
pd.set_option("display.width",300); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",95)

# ---------- Table 1: catalytic / substrate-binding residue set (values computed in earlier UniProt + alignment run)
cat = pd.DataFrame([
 ["Glu (proton donor/acceptor)","active site",86,"E",86,"E",127,"E",95,"E","yes","yes"],
 ["Cys (acyl-thioester intermediate)","active site + HMG-CoA binding",118,"C",120,"C",159,"C",129,"C","yes","yes"],
 ["Thr (HMG-CoA binding)","binding",160,"T",162,"T",201,"T",171,"T","yes","yes"],
 ["Ser (HMG-CoA binding)","binding",209,"S",212,"S",250,"S",221,"S","yes","yes"],
 ["His (proton donor/acceptor + binding)","active site + HMG-CoA binding",259,"H",263,"H",296,"H",264,"H","yes","yes"],
 ["Lys (HMG-CoA binding)","binding",268,"K",272,"K",305,"K",273,"K","yes","yes"],
 ["Asn (HMG-CoA binding)","binding",334,"N",340,"N",371,"N",343,"N","yes","yes"],
 ["Ser (HMG-CoA binding)","binding",368,"S",374,"S",405,"S",377,"S","yes","yes"],
 ["N-term loop residue (not family-conserved)","binding (erg13A only)",35,"A",35,"E",76,"Q",44,"A","yes","no"],
], columns=["residue","UniProt role","erg13A_pos","erg13A_aa","erg13B_pos","erg13B_aa",
            "ScERG13_pos","Sc_aa","HMGCS1_pos","Hs_aa","in_erg13A_UniProt","in_erg13B_UniProt"])
print("TABLE 1. HMG-CoA synthase catalytic and substrate-binding set (UniProt features, positions verified by global alignment)")
print(cat.to_string(index=False))
cat.to_csv("erg13_catalytic_residue_table.csv",index=False)

# ---------- Table 2: identity / orthology
ident = pd.DataFrame([
 ["erg13A vs erg13B (A. fumigatus)",61.0,75.8,"paralogues"],
 ["erg13A vs A. nidulans single copy Q5B3F7",59.8,None,"out-of-clade"],
 ["erg13B vs A. nidulans single copy Q5B3F7",87.6,None,"same clade"],
 ["erg13A vs S. cerevisiae ERG13",56.7,72.9,"out-of-clade"],
 ["erg13B vs S. cerevisiae ERG13",63.6,77.1,"same clade"],
 ["erg13A vs human HMGCS1",51.5,66.1,"-"],
 ["erg13B vs human HMGCS1",53.0,72.3,"-"],
 ["erg13A vs human HMGCS2",50.9,67.4,"-"],
 ["erg13B vs human HMGCS2",49.6,70.4,"-"],
 ["erg13A vs A. oryzae Q2TWN5 (nearest ortholog)",77.3,None,"erg13A clade"],
 ["erg13B vs A. oryzae Q2UKZ2 (nearest ortholog)",85.9,None,"erg13B clade"],
], columns=["comparison","pct_identity","pct_similarity","clade"])
print("\nTABLE 2. Pairwise identity (global Needleman-Wunsch, BLOSUM62, gap -11/-1)")
print(ident.to_string(index=False))
ident.to_csv("erg13_identity_table.csv",index=False)

# ---------- Table 3: three-axis verdict
axes = pd.DataFrame([
 ["1. Catalytic integrity",
  "All 3 active-site residues (E86/E86, C118/C120, H259/H263) and all 7 family-conserved HMG-CoA binding residues present in BOTH; no truncation; no internal indel >13 aa between them; lengths 467 vs 460 aa vs 491 (yeast) and 520 (human)",
  "DOES NOT SEPARATE", "strong (direct sequence + UniProt feature records)"],
 ["1b. Evolutionary retention (sub-axis)",
  "erg13A and erg13B fall in two distinct orthologue clades. erg13B clade present in all 7 Eurotiomycetes sampled (80-88% id, incl. single-copy A. nidulans 87.6% and T. marneffei 80.5%). erg13A clade present only in A. fumigatus/oryzae/flavus/P. rubens/A. niger (75-77% id), absent from A. nidulans and T. marneffei. erg13B closer to yeast and human enzymes on 6/6 outgroups",
  "SEPARATES (weakly, evolutionary only)", "moderate (computational, single-method NJ, no bootstrap)"],
 ["2. Expression",
  "Barker 2012 (PMID 22309491) resolves both loci in hypoxia: both significantly DECREASED, erg13B more than erg13A (same direction). STRING Af293 neighbourhoods identical (Jaccard 0.935; coexpression subscores identical per partner, i.e. homology-transferred, not measured). FungiDB expression API not accessible without a key. No dataset found that reports opposite regulation",
  "DOES NOT SEPARATE qualitatively", "weak-moderate (one fermenter transcriptome; magnitude difference only)"],
 ["3. Requirement",
  "Europe PMC full-text search of both Af293 locus IDs returns 3 (erg13A) and 6 (erg13B) papers, ALL whole-genome transcriptome/proteome surveys or a review. No deletion, no conditional repression, no essentiality call, no double mutant for either gene",
  "EMPTY, DOES NOT SEPARATE", "n/a (absence of evidence)"],
], columns=["axis","what was actually found","verdict","strength"])
print("\nTABLE 3. Three-axis verdict")
for _,r in axes.iterrows():
    print("\n ",r.axis,"->",r.verdict,"[",r.strength,"]")
    print("    ",r["what was actually found"])
axes.to_csv("erg13_three_axis_verdict.csv",index=False)

# ---------- Figure
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(16,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1.1],hspace=0.45,wspace=0.28)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
core=cat[cat["in_erg13B_UniProt"]=="yes"]
y=np.arange(len(core))
ax.scatter([0]*len(core),y,s=190,c="#4f81bd",marker="s")
ax.scatter([1]*len(core),y,s=190,c="#4f81bd",marker="s")
for i,(_,r) in enumerate(core.iterrows()):
    ax.text(0,i,f"{r.erg13A_aa}{r.erg13A_pos}",ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=8,fontweight="bold")
    ax.text(1,i,f"{r.erg13B_aa}{r.erg13B_pos}",ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=8,fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["erg13A\nQ4WBQ3","erg13B\nQ4WXT8"],fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(core["residue"],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlim(-0.6,1.6); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_title("Axis 1: complete catalytic set in both paralogues\n(3 active sites, 5 further HMG-CoA binding residues)",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
og=["Anid_Q5B3F7\n(single copy)","Tmar_B6Q1E0\n(single copy)","Scer_ERG13","Ncra_Q1K5Z3","Spom_hcs1","Hsap_HMGCS1"]
a=[59.8,61.1,56.7,63.8,56.3,51.5]; b=[87.6,80.5,63.6,70.3,60.6,53.0]
p=np.arange(len(og)); w=0.38
ax.barh(p-w/2,a,w,color="#c0504d",label="erg13A")
ax.barh(p+w/2,b,w,color="#4f81bd",label="erg13B")
for v,yy in zip(a,p-w/2): ax.text(v+0.5,yy,f"{v}",va="center",fontsize=8)
for v,yy in zip(b,p+w/2): ax.text(v+0.5,yy,f"{v}",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(p); ax.set_yticklabels(og,fontsize=8); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlim(45,95); ax.set_xlabel("% identity"); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
ax.set_title("Axis 1b: erg13B is closer to every single-copy and\ncharacterised HMG-CoA synthase (6/6 outgroups, sign test p=0.016)",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
cats=["Papers citing\nlocus ID","of which\nparalogue-resolved\nexpression","Deletion /\nrepression /\nessentiality","Double\nperturbation"]
va=[3,1,0,0]; vb=[6,1,0,0]
p=np.arange(len(cats)); w=0.38
ax.bar(p-w/2,va,w,color="#c0504d",label="erg13A (Afu8g07210)")
ax.bar(p+w/2,vb,w,color="#4f81bd",label="erg13B (Afu3g10660)")
for v,xx in zip(va,p-w/2): ax.text(xx,v+0.08,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=9)
for v,xx in zip(vb,p+w/2): ax.text(xx,v+0.08,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(p); ax.set_xticklabels(cats,fontsize=8); ax.set_ylabel("number of publications")
ax.set_ylim(0,7); ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("Axes 2 and 3: the entire literature footprint is\nwhole-genome survey tables (Europe PMC full-text search)",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1]); ax.axis("off")
txt=("Verdict by axis\n\n"
     "1  Catalytic integrity      DOES NOT SEPARATE\n"
     "   Both carry E86, C118/C120, H259/H263 and all five\n"
     "   further HMG-CoA binding residues. Neither truncated.\n"
     "   Neither is a degenerate copy.\n\n"
     "1b Evolutionary retention   SEPARATES, WEAKLY\n"
     "   Two ancestral Eurotiomycete clades. erg13B is the\n"
     "   universally retained copy; the erg13A clade is lost in\n"
     "   A. nidulans and T. marneffei. Bears on dispensability,\n"
     "   not on which pathway branch either gene serves.\n\n"
     "2  Expression               DOES NOT SEPARATE\n"
     "   One study resolves both (PMID 22309491): both fall in\n"
     "   hypoxia, erg13B more than erg13A. Same direction.\n"
     "   STRING neighbourhoods identical (Jaccard 0.935).\n\n"
     "3  Requirement              NO DATA AT ALL\n"
     "   No deletion, no repression, no essentiality call, no\n"
     "   double mutant for either gene.\n\n"
     "Conclusion: the paralogues cannot be distinguished\n"
     "functionally on current evidence.")
ax.text(0,1,txt,va="top",ha="left",fontsize=9.5,family="monospace")
fig.suptitle("A. fumigatus erg13A (Q4WBQ3) and erg13B (Q4WXT8): three-axis test for a division of labour",fontsize=13)
plt.show()
print("\nsaved:",[f for f in os.listdir(".") if f.endswith(".csv")])
